newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Public Bank foreign falls further.
newsitem.headline: Public Bank foreign falls further.

text.p: Foreign shares in Malaysia's Public Bank traded over the counter in Singapore fell further on Thursday after news foreigners would soon be able to buy its local tranche shares.
By 0115 GMT, the stock was down eight cents at Singapore $2.24 on 1.7 million shares after dropping to a fresh 1997 low of S$2.20 in the first few minutes of trade.
"Some people have only just read the papers," said a dealer.
Foreigner investors have been dumping the foreign tranche -- which used to command a premium over the local tranche -- and buying the local stock.
On Wednesday, the foreign shares fell 21 cents to S$2.32.
